subject: Post-demo: Buying committee recap & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@finova.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@finova.com>, Priya Mehra <priya.mehra@finova.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: Buying committee recap & next steps

Hi Alyssa / team —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our demo and suggested next steps so we can keep momentum with the buying committee.

Attendees (as we have them):
- Alyssa Chen — VP Product (Economic buyer)
- Samir Patel — Head of ML / Technical lead
- Priya Mehra — Procurement representative
- Anika Rao — Security lead (please confirm)
- Marissa Cole — Account Exec (Redwood)
- Aditya Rao — Solutions Engineer (Redwood)

Stakeholder mapping / decision criteria we heard today:
1) Latency & reliability: 95th percentile latency under production load is a must.
2) Total unit cost / throughput economics for customer-facing features (tokens / inference cost).
3) Security & compliance: SOC 2 Type II, KMS integration, audit logs, and data-residency constraints.
4) Operational controls: rollouts, canary/fallback policy, and observability hooks.

Open items / asks we committed to:
- Security pack (SOC2 report + architecture diagram + answers to the checklist) — Marissa / Redwood (I will send by EOD 7/16) 
- SSO / infra deep-dive (SSO, VPC connectivity, KMS, audit logs) — Aditya to schedule week of 7/20
- Draft PoC scope + success metrics — attached (finova-poc-scope.pdf).
- Pricing & recommended PoC configuration (instance types, expected throughput) — Marissa to send 7/16
- Procurement / contract questions: Finova procurement to review MSA draft and share redlines — target response by 7/23

Target decision timeline:
- PoC kickoff if approved: target week of 7/27
- Final commercial decision target: week of 8/03 — please confirm if that still aligns with your internal calendar.

Attachments & links:
- Demo recording: https://drive.redwood.com/recordings/20260715-finova-demo (demo-recording.mp4 attached)
- PoC scope: finova-poc-scope.pdf (attached)

Next steps (short):
1) I will send the security pack and draft pricing by 7/16 (Marissa).
2) Aditya will propose 2 slots for an SSO/VPC/KMS deep-dive by 7/20.
3) Alyssa / Priya: confirm procurement contact and expected review timeline.
4) Samir: share any additional non-functional reqs (throughput, seq length distribution) you want the PoC to mirror.

If you want, we can also provide a short one-week PoC template with test prompts/metrics to measure quality and cost during the trial.

Thanks — look forward to next steps.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: finova-poc-scope.pdf, demo-recording.mp4

Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 17:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Buying committee recap & next steps

Thanks Marissa — great summary. A couple quick things from our side:

- Confirming I am the economic buyer and will sign off on commercials once procurement clears the MSA.
- Procurement contact for paperwork and redlines is procurement@finova.com (cc'd). Priya will help coordinate timelines.
- Security lead is Anika Rao (cc'd) — Anika will own the SOC2 / architecture review but will expect the security pack you mentioned.
- Data residency: our initial preference is US-only; if Redwood offers region pinning for the PoC that would help.

Please include SOC2 evidence and anything on key management (KMS/HSM) in the pack. Also include a short note on audit log retention & access controls.

Target decision timeline looks reasonable — I will confirm with Legal & Procurement and get back with any conflicts.

Thanks,
Alyssa
VP Product, Finova
alyssa.chen@finova.com

Thanks Alyssa — adding a few items inline and attaching our security pack and draft MSA for procurement review.

Anika / Priya / procurement team — attached: redwood-security-pack.pdf and a draft MSA (MSA-Finova-Redwood-draft.docx). The security pack includes:
- SOC 2 Type II attestation (summary)
- High-level architecture diagram for Redwood Private & Dedicated options
- KMS integration notes (we support customer-managed KMS via AWS KMS/HSM integrations)
- Audit log retention and retrieval process
- Standard encryption in transit & at rest details

Rishi (cc'd) will be the Redwood security contact for any deeper questions; Rishi, can you take the lead on Anika's checklist and propose answers by 7/21?

Aditya will reach out with SSO/VPC slots tomorrow.

Doc links: HubSpot deal record (internal): https://hubspot.redwood.com/deal/DEAL-3281
DocuSign (MSA pre-send link): https://docusign.com/envelope/ABCD1234

Next commercial step: once procurement shares redlines we'll route to Legal for a review. If everything looks standard we can propose a one-week PoC and then convert to a short reserved capacity pilot.

Thanks all —
Marissa
